38. A capacitor of capacitance $C$ discharges through a resistor of resistance $R$. The graph shows the variation with time $t$ of the voltage $V$ across the capacitor.
[Graph: V / V (0.0 to 1.2) against t / s (0.0 to 1.6); exponential decay from 1.0 V, about 0.37 V near 0.45 s, levelling near zero by 1.2 s]
The capacitor is changed to one of value $2C$ and the resistor is changed to one of value $2R$. Which graph shows the variation with $t$ of $V$ when the new combination is discharged?
[Options A–D: same axes, decays from 1.0 V. A identical to original; B slower decay reaching about 0.4 V at 1.6 s; C very rapid decay to zero by 0.2 s; D faster decay than original, near zero by about 0.8 s]

questions.text:
39.  Monochromatic electromagnetic radiation is incident on a metal surface.  The kinetic energy of the
electrons released from the metal
A.  is constant because the photons have a constant energy.
B.  is constant because the metal has a constant work function.
C.  varies because the electrons are not equally bound to the metal lattice.
D.  varies because the work function of the metal is different for different electrons.
